items: The techniques of chromatography are very useful in organic synthesis for the separation, isolation and purification of products, and equally important in qualitative and quantitative analysis and for determining the purity of a substance.
Chromatography is very useful for identifying complicated chemicals such as dyes, drugs and pesticides.

blocks.prompt: Give three practical applications of paper chromatography (exercise Q.5).
blocks.explanation: Checking the purity of a product from an organic synthesis (one spot or several); identifying the dyes in an ink or a food colouring by comparing Rf values with known dyes; and detecting drugs or pesticide residues in a sample against reference compounds.

items: Uses: separation, isolation and purification of synthetic products; qualitative and quantitative analysis; purity checks; identifying dyes, drugs and pesticides.
